hotelName: Park Avenue Bayswater Inn Hyde Park
title: Shocking
text:
Here are the pros and cons of this place:

Con:
1. Very small room. Struggled to open our suitcases
2. Was absolutely shocked to find blood stains on the throw (see image). We complained on the first night and were told that they would deal with it. 2 days later, they gave us the exact same blood stain throw!! I question whether or not the sheets are actually replaced during housekeeping.

Pro:
Great location! Close to the tube stations and restaurants.
Staff were nice.
